classification.difficultyReason: Identify columns where x must first be recovered from a supplied expression value, reverse the linear operations, then substitute that x into the remaining rows.

answer.worked:
Columns are counted from left to right, excluding the row-label column.

Column 1, $x=3$:
$$\begin{align*}2x-4&=2(3)-4\\2x-4&=2\end{align*}$$
